Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (2025-07-02 17:00 PT):
- Add a one-paragraph justification to the scorecard (link below) focusing on the anchor questions I called out.
- If you are willing to be the tiebreaker, reply here and I will schedule a 15-min sync with the hiring panel + recruiter.

Link to scorecard and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4driveLinkExample
Attachments: resume-Alex-Mercer.pdf, scorecard-Alex-Mercer-v1.xlsx (stub)

If we get unanimous thumbs-up after anchors, I'll send the offer template to Recruiting. If we remain split, we'll do a 15-min tiebreak tomorrow 10:30–10:45 PT (I can adjust).
